samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>A Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to the FSM.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE = 0;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State S1 = 1;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State S2 = 2;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State S3 = 3;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State S4 = 4;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State S5 = 5;</parameter>
        <parameter id="S6">State S6 = 6;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="next_state" width_description="[3:0]" type="reg">Next state register.</signal>
        <always_comb>
            case(state)
                IDLE: next_state = IN ? S1 : IDLE;
                S1: next_state = ~IN ? S2 : IDLE;
                S2: next_state = ~IN ? S3 : IDLE;
                S3: next_state = IN ? S4 : IDLE;
                S4: next_state = IN ? S5 : IDLE;
                S5: next_state = IN ? S6 : IDLE;
                S6: next_state = IN ? S1 : IDLE;
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="state" width_description="[3:0]" type="reg">State register.</signal>
        <always_ff @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if(RST) begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign MATCH = ((state == S5 || state == S6) && IN) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </logic_description>
</module>
